headline: FBI 🕵️ HACKED 💻 Agents' BLOOD 🩸 And URINE 💧 Tests STOLEN 🦹
text:
SHINYHUNTERS 🕴️ just COOKED 🍳 the FBI 🏛️ by SNATCHING 👐 thousands of SPECIAL 🦸 agents' BLOOD 🩸 and URINE 💧 test results from their own MEDLINK 🩺 system after breaching an ORACLE ☁️ cloud storage on MONDAY 📅!! The cyber-criminals 🧨 posted SAMPLES 🧪 of the "fitness-for-work" 🏋️ medical EXAMINATIONS 📋 which include full NAMES 🏷️ addresses 🏠 phone 📱 numbers badge 🔖 numbers job titles and even DOCTORS 📝 notes mentioning things like SHELLFISH 🦞 and BANANA 🍌 allergies plus references to BLOOD 🩸 in the urine and HIGH 🏔️ cholesterol!! Experts 🧠 say this HACK 🕳️ could leave the agents totally VULNERABLE 🛡️ to SCAMS 💰 BLACKMAIL 📧 and targeted ATTACKS ⚔️ while helping criminals IMPERSONATE 👤 law enforcement because once MEDICAL 🩹 records are OUT 🆓 they stay COMPROMISED 🧨 forever unlike PASSWORDS 🔑 that can just be RESET 🔄!! Etay Maor from CATO 🛡️ NETWORKS called it mapping THOUSANDS 📊 of agents against their MEDICAL 🩺 and FITNESS 🏋️ records adding that the PERMANENCE 🕰️ across an entire WORKFORCE 👥 makes this LEAK 💦 so SERIOUS 😱 and the FBI is now AGGRESSIVELY 🏃‍♂️ investigating while the hackers demand a RETRACTION 📜 of a May advisory that apparently OFFENDED 😤 them instead of just asking for CASH 💵!!

The group SHINYHUNTERS ✨ shared legit looking SAMPLES 🧪 with reporters via TELEGRAM 📨 including info on SPOUSES 💍 and even SENIOR 🧓 officials like DEPUTY directors plus details from a little-known HACKING 🔓 unit and records tied to investigations on RUSSIA 🇷🇺 CHINA 🇨🇳 and DRUG 🚬 cartels!! Professor Ciaran Martin called it as SERIOUS 😬 as it gets for a DATA 📊 breach while Reuters and 404 MEDIA 📡 reported it might affect way more than the initial 38000 current EMPLOYEES 👔 because the hackers now claim they actually snagged stuff on around 60000 CURRENT 🕒 and FORMER 🕒 FBI staff after underestimating the SCALE 📏 of the theft!! Jamie Akhtar from CYBERSMART 🛡️ warned the data could fuel super CONVINCING 🕵️ phishing IMPERSONATION 👤 identity FRAUD 🕵️ blackmail or even direct OPERATIONS 🎯 targeting law-enforcement personnel making the whole situation particularly DIRE 🆘 and the hackers say they will DUMP 🗑️ the full DATASET 📦 in five days unless the FBI meets their weird non-monetary DEMANDS 📜!!

FBI agents are now DOWN BAD 😵 after their most PRIVATE 🕳️ medical secrets got YEETED 🪃 onto the darknet by this INTERNATIONAL 🌍 hacking COLLECTIVE 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 that's been active since 2019 and previously hit ROCKSTAR 🎮 GAMES and the education platform CANVAS 📚!! The crew claims they EXPLOITED 🛠️ a vulnerability in an ORACLE ☁️ cloud system used by the FBI to access multiple PLATFORMS 🖥️ including FBIJOBS 💼 FBI BEAST 🐺 for background CHECKS ✅ FBI MEDLINK 🩺 for medical records and FBI BICS 📋 that holds investigative intel which means the breach could be either DIRECT 🎯 or through a THIRD-PARTY 🤝 provider!! In a statement on X the bureau said they are still trying to FIGURE 🧩 out exactly how it happened while working closely with those third-party providers supporting FBIJOBS.GOV to MITIGATE 🛡️ any and all RISK ⚠️ and they have not responded to most requests for COMMENT 🗣️ yet!!

This hack is straight-up COOKING 🍳 the entire agency because medical data like blood 🩸 urine 💧 results and doctors notes about allergies or conditions cannot be RESET 🔄 like stolen passwords so once it's leaked it stays out there FOREVER ♾️ creating permanent exposure across the whole WORKFORCE 👥!! The samples the hackers dropped appear totally GENUINE ✅ with names addresses phone numbers badge numbers job titles spouse info and even details on senior officials which experts say opens the door to highly targeted SCAMS 💸 BLACKMAIL 📨 and impersonation attacks that could COMPROMISE 🕳️ ongoing investigations or put agents and their families at REAL 🩸 physical RISK ⚡!! ShinyHunters is demanding the FBI retract an advisory from May that they claim OFFENDED 😠 them instead of the usual ransom and they posted the attack details on their darknet site after initially BREACHING 🕳️ the systems on Monday with the full dataset scheduled to DROP 💥 in five days unless their terms are MET 🤝!!

Cyber experts are treating the hackers claims with some CAUTION ⚠️ but still calling the breach extremely CONCERNING 😟 because such sensitive fitness-for-work examinations could be weaponized for phishing identity fraud or even operations aimed directly at law-enforcement PERSONNEL 👮 making the potential implications particularly DIRE 🆘 and the FBI has acknowledged the incident while saying they are aggressively INVESTIGATING 🕵️ how it all went down!! The group underestimated the SCALE 📏 at first thinking it was just the 38000 current employees but now insists they hold compromising MEDICAL 🩺 and fitness data on around 60000 current and former STAFF 🧑‍🚀 which if true would be an absolute CATASTROPHE 🌋 for the bureau's operational SECURITY 🔐 and the whole thing traces back to a vulnerability in that ORACLE ☁️ cloud storage used across FBIJOBS FBI BEAST FBI MEDLINK and FBI BICS platforms!!
